Read out of saint.gr's line for 11 Μαρτίου, «Άγιος Σωφρόνιος Πατριάρχης Ιεροσολύμων», with the rank words left off.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 11 martie — «Sfântul Ierarh Sofronie, Patriarhul Ierusalimului»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 11ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιος Σωφρόνιος Πατριάρχης Ιεροσολύμων»

attestations.note: The page heads him «(; - 638)», puts his birth at Damascus «περί το έτος 580 μ.Χ.» of parents Plinthas and Myro, calls him also Damaskenos, and records a relic: «Η Κάρα του Αγίου βρίσκεται στη Μονή Φανερωμένης Χιλιομοδίου Κορινθίας» — his head at the monastery of the Phaneromeni at Chiliomodi in Corinthia.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

hymns.text: Îndreptător credinţei şi chip blândeţelor, învăţător înfrânârii te-a arătat pe tine, turmei tale, adevărul lucrurilor. Pentru aceasta ai dobândit cu smerenia cele înalte şi cu sărăcia cele bogate; Părinte Ierarhe Sofronie, roagă pe Hristos Dumnezeu să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Ierarh Sofronie, Patriarhul Ierusalimului, glasul 4

english.text: The truth of things has shown you to your flock as a rule of faith, an image of gentleness and a teacher of abstinence. Therefore you gained the heights by humility and riches by poverty; father and hierarch Sophronius, pray to Christ God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: De râvna cea Dumnezeiască fiind pus în mişcare şi lărgind gura Poruncilor celor adevăra­te, temeliile Bisericii după Lege le-ai aşezat; şi cuvinte preaînţelepte dând călugărilor celor ce se aflau acolo, te-ai arătat lumii preaînţelepte între patri­arhii Ierusalimului, Sfinte Ierarhe Sofronie. Prin care, îndreptându-ne, stri­găm ţie: bucură-te, lauda cea luminoasă a credincioşilor!

source.text: Doxologia — Condacul Sfântului Ierarh Sofronie, Patriarhul Ierusalimului, glasul 8, podobie «Apărătoare Doamnă...»

english.text: Moved by divine zeal, and opening wide your mouth upon the true commandments, you laid the foundations of the Church according to the Law; and giving most wise words to the monks who were there, you were shown to the world as most wise among the patriarchs of Jerusalem, holy hierarch Sophronius. Being set right by them, we cry to you: rejoice, bright praise of the faithful!

hymns.text: Κανόνα πίστεως, καὶ εἰκόνα πραότητος, ἐγκρατείας διδάσκαλον, ἀνέδειξε σε τῇ ποίμνῃ σου, ἡ τῶν πραγμάτων ἀλήθεια· διὰ τοῦτο ἐκτήσω τῇ ταπεινώσει τὰ ὑψηλά, τῇ πτωχείᾳ τὰ πλούσια. Πάτερ Ἱεράρχα Σωφρόνιε, πρέσβευε Χριστῷ τῷ θεῷ, σωθῆναι τὰς ψυχὰς ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr — Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος δ’, on the page of Άγιος Σωφρόνιος Πατριάρχης Ιεροσολύμων. It is the common of a hierarch, with his own name in it — Πάτερ Ἱεράρχα Σωφρόνιε — and so is his service; the page prints a second apolytikion in Ἦχος πλ. α’, a kathisma and this kontakion beside it.

english.text: The truth of things has shown you to your flock as a rule of faith, an image of meekness and a teacher of abstinence; therefore you gained the heights by humility and riches by poverty. Father and hierarch Sophronius, intercede with Christ our God that our souls be saved.

hymns.text: Λαμπρυνθείς τοῦ Πνεύματος τῆ ἐπιπνοίᾳ, Ἱεράρχης ὅσιος, ὡς Ἀποστόλων μιμητής, ἐν τῇ Σιὼν ἐχρημάτισας, Πάτερ παμμάκαρ, Σωφρόνιε πάνσοφε.

source.text: saint.gr — Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος δ’, Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον, on the same page.

english.text: Made bright by the breathing of the Spirit, you served as a holy hierarch in Sion, an imitator of the Apostles, all-blessed father, all-wise Sophronius.

birth.note: saint.gr: «Ο Άγιος Σωφρόνιος γεννήθηκε στην Δαμασκό της Συρίας περί το έτος 580 μ.Χ. και ήταν υιός ευσεβών και ενάρετων γονέων, του Πλινθά και της Μυρούς» — the page's «περί», about, is why the display says about 580.

death.note: saint.gr heads him «Αγιος Σωφρονιος Πατριαρχης Ιεροσολυμων (; - 638)».
